metrics.method: Manual pass over all 320 records. 'Client questions' = messages from Barb Brazil containing an explicit question or request for action or decision (repeat nudges on the same item counted once). 'Unanswered >24h' = no substantive reply within 24h of the first ask, including still-open items; holding replies ('Yo Ma'am', 'I'll get you an answer soon', 'Working on it!!') and pure @-tags were not counted as answers. max_team_silence_days = longest calendar gap with zero outbound from any of Derrek/Stephski/Mayson/Michelle/Mica/Olivia/Vivek (2026-08-06 15:19 -> 2026-08-08 18:56); note this understates the real gap, since on the IG/traffic issue specifically we were silent 2026-08-12 -> 2026-08-21 and again 2026-08-24 -> present. Promises = explicit commitments by our side ('I will', 'let me get back to you', 'next week', or an accepted request); 1 further standing offer (Michelle's open leak-link offer, Aug 26) is not counted in either column.

what_client_wanted: Traffic and growth she can see going up, not down — 'i definitely wanna see my numbers increase not keep going down 😭' (2026-08-24). She has never been shown a single view count, posting log or growth number in 39 days.

A straight answer on why her IG accounts keep dying, and to be treated as a partner in diagnosing it — 'i'm trying to trace what could be root cause' (2026-08-11). She was told 'Dont worry about why' the same day.

To be told what is safe to post so she can stop guessing — 'do you guys think this would get flagged ... it's my first post back i'm nervous' (2026-07-24), 'is this too risqué' (2026-08-18). No written guidance ever issued.

Someone to actually use the content she keeps producing — 'I have over 300 reels of all sorts in this folder' (2026-07-30) and 'how are we doing with editing on the other video i had submitted to the team?' (2026-08-27, her third ask). Neither drop has ever been acknowledged as used.
what_worked: Olivia turning the client's own idea into a delivered shoot in 10 days — Barbara pitched a gun-range OFTV on Aug 17, Olivia found the videographer, took her number and built the group chat, and the shoot happened Aug 27: 'I had the best time today shooting and shooting 🔫 / Ben is awesome' (2026-08-27). This is the first tangible outcome delivered on this account since onboarding.

Michelle's weekly DMCA leak-removal report — three consecutive weeks (Aug 10, 17, 25), the only reliable unprompted cadence on the account. The client thanks it every single time: 'Thank you Michelle!' (2026-08-10), 'Thanks Michelle !!' (2026-08-27). Proof that a small, dependable, repeating deliverable buys goodwill.

Fast, specific onboarding content help in week 1 — Michelle's reel inspo drop and her plain-language 'what does well on Reels' list drew the warmest reaction of the whole history: 'this is perfect i love this' (2026-07-22). We were good at this for about ten days and then stopped.
top_fix: Give every client one named account owner who ships a short written update every week containing actual numbers — posts made, views, follower delta, account status, and the current open-promise list with dates. Nothing on this account failed for lack of goodwill; it failed because no unprompted status ever existed, so the client became our monitoring system. A weekly numbers update would have surfaced the traffic collapse before she did, forced the 18 lapsed promises into daylight while they were days old rather than weeks, and removed the need for her to tag three people to get one answer.
